product.name: Ledgerline
product.one_liner: Reconciliation for finance teams that still close the books in spreadsheets.

capacity.note: Not inventory. This is how many new seats implementation and support can actually stand up this month - two solutions engineers at roughly 60 seats each. Selling past it produces a churned account, not a bigger month.

campaign.name: Finance-team reconciliation - Q3 outbound
campaign.icp: Finance teams of 10-60 at 100-800 person companies still closing the month in spreadsheets, on NetSuite or QuickBooks, where a controller has publicly posted about close times. The operator owns this definition; we do not widen it to lengthen the list.
campaign.offer: A twelve-month Team subscription at a per-seat rate, onboarding inside two weeks, with the first close run alongside their existing process.
campaign.notes: No escalation on this campaign. There is nobody to ask mid-call: the agent closes inside the floor or thanks them and ends. Every concession must be re-checked against the combined deal, never against its own cap - three capped concessions stack into a 25% discount.
